memories.content: The second-line team handles escalated warranty claims. They have a queue of claims and aim to respond within ten working days as per their quoted policy. They have received Rustam's escalated claim and have the necessary information to make a decision.

Rustam's washing machine failed and he filed a warranty claim. The claim was escalated to the manufacturer's second-line team. Yesterday (2026-08-04), the manufacturer sent an email to Rustam stating that the second-line team would make a decision within ten working days. The ten working days count from 2026-08-05 to 2026-08-18 (excluding weekends). The hard cutoff for resolution is 2026-08-19T18:00:00+05:00.
